replay.source: Copernicus EMS EMSR838 (flood extent), ERA5 rain and GloFAS discharge through Open-Meteo
assumptions: every point treated as low-lying for Rule A (an upper bound)
river reach: within 48 km of a river point, lag at 4 km/h
the danger level of a river point is the 90th percentile of its own baseline days, not an official level
the quiet window is assumed not flooded, not confirmed
replay.ruleB: not independently validated: the flood extent was itself made from radar, so scoring the radar rule against it would be circular
replay.scale: Rain is a 25 km grid cell and river discharge a daily value on a 5 km grid; the flood extent was mapped at tens of metres. Every point in one rain cell gets the same rain.

credits.text: Flood extent: Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© European Union), EMSR838, first delivered flood-extent products.
Rain (ERA5) and river discharge (GloFAS): weather data by Open-Meteo.com, CC BY 4.0, non-commercial use. Generated using Copernicus Climate Change Service information.
